answer.text: Use 10W40 engine oil that meets API SN and JASO MA2 and is semi synthetic.
For an oil change with a new oil filter, the manual gives a refill quantity of 2.1 L.

policy.text: The manual says the oil capacity values are approximate and the actual capacity will vary.

watchouts.text: Using the wrong oil grade reduces the life of the moving parts and seriously affects performance.

watchout_review.reason: States the consequence of using the wrong oil grade, which the answer does not give.
